title: Kumo Kumo no Mi

facts: Appearance: not revealed (plain swirl fruit stands in)

plan.fruit: The fruit's appearance **has never been revealed**, so a plain round swirl fruit in spider brown stands in (no face or limbs). The script says "a weird swirly fruit".
cast: **Enemy (new, original):** a sumo wrestler with a topknot and a belt.

**Black Maria:** giant woman with black hair in a tall bun with red-tipped pins, red lips, pipe, dark-purple robe over red; shown in her centaur-like hybrid form on a spider body (the form she used in Wano). Send a reference to match her exactly.
**Sanji:** blond hair over one eye, curly eyebrow, black suit, cigarette.
**Robin:** long black hair, purple top, white pants; her extra arms bloom from the floor.
